name: HeaderHawk
description: An advanced email security analysis MCP server for real-time phishing detection, comprehensive header analysis, and threat intelligence integration. It enables users to extract indicators of compromise and validate email authentication protocols like DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.

rawRecord.description: An advanced email security analysis MCP server for real-time phishing detection, comprehensive header analysis, and threat intelligence integration. It enables users to extract indicators of compromise and validate email authentication protocols like DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.

OUTPUT_FORMAT.description: Optional: Output format for results, either 'json' or 'text' (default).

HIGH_THRESHOLD.description: Optional: Threat level threshold for high risk assessment.

CRITICAL_THRESHOLD.description: Optional: Threat level threshold for critical risk assessment.

VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY.description: VirusTotal API key used for threat scanning features. Required for the scan_with_virustotal function.

VIRUSTOTAL_RATE_LIMIT.description: Optional: API rate limiting for VirusTotal (requests per minute). Default is 4.
